keyEvents.text: Chris Rigg (Sunderland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sunderland. Luke O'Nien replaces Omar Alderete because of an injury.
First Half ends, Sunderland 0, Jagiellonia Białystok 0.
Substitution, Sunderland. Thomas Meunier replaces Trai Hume.
Substitution, Sunderland. Jules Ahoka replaces Noah Sadiki.
Second Half begins Sunderland 0, Jagiellonia Białystok 0.
Goal! Sunderland 1, Jagiellonia Białystok 0. Tymur Tutierov (Sunderland) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Enzo Le Fée.
Goal! Sunderland 1, Jagiellonia Białystok 1. Kamil Józwiak (Jagiellonia Białystok) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Sunderland. Chemsdine Talbi replaces Enzo Le Fée.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Białystok. Jesús Imaz replaces Anders Klynge.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Białystok. Norbert Wojtuszek replaces Rodrigo Conceição.
Eryk Kozlowski (Jagiellonia Białystok) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Jagiellonia Białystok. Jeremy Agbonifo replaces Kajetan Szmyt.
Substitution, Sunderland. Wilson Isidor replaces Tymur Tutierov.
Jeremy Agbonifo (Jagiellonia Białystok) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
